title: New Permanent Representative of Israel Presents Credentials to the Director-General of the United Nations Office at Geneva
summary: Jonathan Peled, the new Permanent Representative of Israel to the United Nations Office at Geneva, today presented his credentials to Tatiana Valovaya, the Director-General of the United Nations Office at Geneva.Prior to his appointment in Geneva, Mr. Peled served as Israel’s Ambassador to Italy…
author: ungeneva.org
